newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate rises to 20.5875 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate rises to 20.5875 pct.

text.p: Mexico's 28-day interbank interest rate (TIIE) rose by 47 basis points to 20.5875 percent on Wednesday from 20.1175 percent on Tuesday, Banco de Mexico said.
The TIIP fell 74.76 basis points to 20.5965 percent on Wednesday from 21.3441 percent the week before.
The 91-day TIIE meanwhile fell 78.50 basis points to 22.00 percent on Wednesday from 22.7850 percent the week before.
The TIIE is a market-weighted average interbank rate that is replacing the TIIP, an average interbank rate.
